headline: Palworld Pal Souls explained
title: Pal Souls Explained | Statue of Power | Palworld Guide
video_script: Want stronger Pals without breeding in Palworld? Use the Statue of Power. Feed it Pal Souls and each rank adds about three percent to one stat: health, attack, defense or work speed. Souls come in small, medium, large and giant sizes, and the bigger ones drop from tougher Pals and chests in higher level zones. You can build a statue yourself early in the game. Which stat do you boost first? Comment below!
description: Palworld Pal Souls: spend them at the Statue of Power for about 3% per rank on health, attack, defense or work speed.
